lines.text: Many learners say: I want you help me.

You to! I want you to help me.

en.tip: Add to after want you. Say “I want you to help me.”
en.caption: Do you say “I want you help me” in English? 😅 After want and a person, English needs “to”. “I want you to help me” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
